title: 公式が最大手すぐる件

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Uhhh, Trainer. There's something I'd like to talk to you about real quick…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital stops me while I'm walking down the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You wouldn't happen to know a good way to swap out Tachyon's socks without her knowing, would you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, right. Well, when I passed her in the hallway earlier, I noticed her knee-highs were sagging just a smidge.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My guess is the elastic is starting to go. I must have missed it when I was folding and putting away the laundry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I-it's not what you're thinking! It's just Tachyon never puts away her clean clothes, and I don't want them to get mixed up with her dirty ones!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But look at what my sloppy work has done. It must be annoying for her having her knee-highs constantly sagging.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to swap them out! And in order to protect her honor, I wanna prevent her from knowing anything!
Bravo! What a perfectly wonderful display of friendship!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Digital! The sight of you anguishing over the threat to your friend's good name tugs at my heartstrings.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You've inspired me to impart a technique to you that can be used to keep your torch of friendship aflame.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: S-seriously?! Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then, you must choose! Will you go on the offensive and boldy swap the socks by force, or would you prefer the elegance of a more delicate method?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll take either method with open arms!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In that case, perhaps your trainer can choose in your stead.
choice_data_list: Let's seize them in a show of force!
Smart and elegant, if you please.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let us paint your friendship in the fierce shades of battle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You called for me. What is it you need?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmph… You can help with this!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is Opera O offering her the socks?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon! I challenge thee!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaagh! No, it's a challenge! Things are getting seriously moe!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A duel between Opera O and Tachyon! Fwoojhh! This is the stuff of every otaku's dreams!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Who wouldn't want to see two polar opposites paired together? The arts against the sciences! Talk about prime shipping material!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes… To put it another way, it's like a duel between a knight commander and an arch wizard! Nyghk! It's moe to the very last drop!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And this is?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The alternative for a dueling glove! Because I wish not to put a strain our relationship, I will refrain from slapping you with it.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You'll find a pair of socks inside. We've wrapped them in an effort to make them less conspicuous—a token of your friend's consideration.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You challenged me to a duel for the purpose of giving me a pair of socks?! Ahahaha! That concept of yours—skill enhancement through pure auto-suggestion—I find it fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But examining you would take a great amount of time that I simply do not have. There are more pressing experiments I must attend to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As for the socks… I've already gone half a day wearing this pair, so it shouldn't be too much trouble to finish the rest with them. Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I say! What a marvelous opponent!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: How casually she insinuates to Digital that concern is not needed… and with such kindness! The spirit of friendship between them stirs my heart!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And yet… Digital. Why the long face?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The duel… Ghhh… I wanted to see you duel!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! I see! Despondent over the missed opportunity to gaze upon my heroic visage, eh?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll be sure to invite you to my next performance of Haoengrin!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwoagh! That sounds bliss inducing! I'll need to bring a whole bath towel to soak up my tears!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the "moe" situation Agnes Digital encountered has fully washed away her worries.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Understood! Let us color your friendship with elegance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, my fair lady. Might I trouble you for a moment? You see, my friend here and I are looking for someone.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We're trying to find the owner of this item here. Digital, if you would be so kind.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, right! We're trying to find an Umamusume whose legs fit these socks perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if we tried them on your lovely calves, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I don't mind being a subject in your test. Go ahead and put them on me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …You want me to do it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You're the one running this experiment, no? You must operate with your own hands if you're to ensure your results are accurate!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: True, the burden is not Tachyon's to bear. Prove your mettle, Digital!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead. Although, it'll probably be easier if you come a bit closer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-th-th-th…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This is beyond my wildest dreeeams! It's too much moe to handle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital flees the scene with an expression torn between joy and tears.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… It appears that's the limit to how close she can get to me. Next, I'll need to conduct a thorough analysis of her mental state.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It appears the one truly being experimented on was Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Oh, and I'll go ahead and take this. Now that I think of it, these socks I have on today might be a bit loose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hand over the new socks to Agnes Tachyon. With that accomplished, I go looking for Agnes Digital to report on our success.
